status: Conditional candidates distilled from inspected research; not installed integrations or proven optimal combinations.
source_detail: reverse-engineering-catalog.md, ui-continuity.md, expert-integration.md, formal-methods.md and surface-methods.md; preserve nuance and refresh sources before adoption.

methods.mechanism: Identify payload frameworks before choosing analysis tools.
methods.invariant: Inspect all relevant package components.
methods.delta: Mixed frameworks and SDKs can defeat a single framework label.
methods.probe: Compare detected payload with native libraries, assets and entry components.
methods.limit: Detection and recovered names remain hypotheses.
methods.conditions: Packaged input is accessible; analyst-side in strict mode.

methods.mechanism: Use selective decompilation, resources and xrefs with raw bytecode retained.
methods.invariant: Unresolved logic remains explicit.
methods.delta: Alternative representations can distinguish decompiler artifacts.
methods.probe: Inspect disputed operation in bytecode and another decompilation mode.
methods.limit: Decompilation is partial and does not prove reachable behavior.
methods.conditions: Relevant logic resides in DEX, not solely native or Dart code.

methods.mechanism: Recover version-matched AOT structure and narrow runtime hooks.
methods.invariant: Keep original build and patched observation separate.
methods.delta: Blutter static recovery and reFlutter instrumentation answer different questions.
methods.probe: Map one relevant call and compare patched/unmodified behavior.
methods.limit: Version-specific setup and hooks do not recover all states.
methods.conditions: Dart AOT version is identifiable; runtime instrumentation is authorized.

methods.mechanism: Map Dart/native platform-channel relationships.
methods.invariant: Carry uncertainty across unresolved bridge edges.
methods.delta: Whole-language graphs miss behavior crossing platform channels.
methods.probe: Correlate a channel call with both endpoint evidence.
methods.limit: GlassWing security metrics are not fidelity metrics; full rebuild unverified.
methods.license: Apache-2.0 declared; bundled components need review
methods.conditions: Flutter behavior crosses Java/Kotlin/native boundaries.

methods.mechanism: Recover resources/schema before critical method behavior.
methods.invariant: Track metadata-only/stubbed/failed/recovered-unvalidated/differential-tested separately.
methods.delta: Cpp2IL recovery differs from default empty-method AssetRipper/Dumper outputs.
methods.probe: Inspect critical generated method bodies before accepting restoration.
methods.limit: Importable projects and method counts do not establish executable equivalence.
methods.conditions: Unity format/version matches actual tool support.

methods.mechanism: Inspect HBC version and retrieve function/string tables before broad model context.
methods.invariant: Distinguish pseudocode from runnable JavaScript.
methods.delta: hermes_rs and hermes-dec support different formats and recovery layers.
methods.probe: Check header compatibility and correlate an async/native bridge with observation.
methods.limit: No general functional decompiler established.
methods.conditions: React Native payload actually contains supported Hermes bytecode.

methods.mechanism: Request relevant xrefs, ranged decompilation and data-flow slices.
methods.invariant: Return caps and unresolved IR explicitly.
methods.delta: ReVa bounds context while ghidra-rpc avoids repeated project loading.
methods.probe: Find writers of a relevant value; inspect truncation and missing indirect edges.
methods.limit: Recovered IR, caps and cache identity constrain evidence.
methods.conditions: Binary is supported; query answers a consequential uncertainty.

methods.mechanism: Extract deterministic symbols/graphs before demand-driven summaries.
methods.invariant: Keep raw evidence and relevant non-security findings.
methods.delta: GhidrAssist full-text retrieval differs from Serena LSP and Joern code-property queries.
methods.probe: Check a bounded control/data-flow query against actual source and unresolved calls.
methods.limit: Parseability, reflection and source/tool/config cache identity matter.
methods.license: Apache-2.0; GhidrAssist MIT; Serena mixed MIT/GPL
methods.conditions: Source or reconstructed code parses reliably; strict mode analyst-side only.

methods.mechanism: Retain immutable evidence dependencies and contradictions.
methods.invariant: Rehash actual artifacts rather than certify by field presence.
methods.delta: Cerberus graph integrity does not establish semantic truth.
methods.probe: Change a declared dependency and inspect affected claims.
methods.limit: Undeclared dependencies and wrong claims survive structural checks.
methods.conditions: Long investigation or consequential handoff benefits from durable provenance.

methods.mechanism: Explore unexplored actions and reuse navigation paths.
methods.invariant: Retain raw observations and split states when future outcomes differ.
methods.delta: DroidBot structural hashes omit position/multiplicity/text detail.
methods.probe: Use a future action suffix to distinguish visually similar states.
methods.limit: State clustering is not behavioral equivalence.
methods.conditions: Safe reset and task-owned device exist; deterministic breadth is useful.

methods.mechanism: Reuse successful action routes with guarded pre/postconditions.
methods.invariant: Missing observations must never mean unchanged; reacquire targets.
methods.delta: Mobilerun macros and MobiAgent task caches differ in retrieval and target checks.
methods.probe: Check package/activity, nonempty state, geometry and actual postcondition.
methods.limit: Cold start, fuzzy misses and stale coordinates can outweigh savings.
methods.conditions: Repeated routes are stable and current target identity is observable.

methods.mechanism: Use semantic/visual grounding for custom controls and deep workflows.
methods.invariant: Treat boxes and action predictions as hypotheses confirmed by resulting state.
methods.delta: GUI-Owl/UI-TARS/Agent S differ in deployment and role costs; OmniParser supplies perception.
methods.probe: Ground a decisive control and inspect result, including observer quality.
methods.limit: Model terms, deployment support, inference and repeated rollouts need separate review.
methods.license: Apache-2.0; other code/weights have separate terms
methods.conditions: Cheap semantic navigation is insufficient and authorized control is available.

methods.mechanism: Use preconditions, guided scenarios and assertions to reach deep states.
methods.invariant: Preserve action history and noncrashing failure evidence.
methods.delta: Kea rules supply guidance without an LLM per action.
methods.probe: Specify a deep-state precondition and meaningful observable postcondition.
methods.limit: Kea2/Fastbot restrictive licenses are not inherited from original Kea.
methods.conditions: A bounded feature has observable preconditions and assertions.

methods.mechanism: Learn small state models from sequences and counterexamples.
methods.invariant: Similar current output does not imply identical future behavior.
methods.delta: AALpy query caches and LearnLib reuse reduce reset work differently.
methods.probe: Find a distinguishing action suffix; investigate conflicting outputs.
methods.limit: W-method growth, stochasticity and bad resets can invalidate models.
methods.conditions: Behavior can be scoped to a finite model and reset meaningfully.

methods.mechanism: Drive both systems through semantic action sequences and shrink discrepancies.
methods.invariant: Both adapters implement the same action semantics and normalizers preserve relevant differences.
methods.delta: Hypothesis shrinking gives compact counterexamples instead of long failure sessions.
methods.probe: Minimize a failing sequence without losing the observed discrepancy.
methods.limit: Loose normalization and flaky reset can falsely accept or reject.
methods.conditions: Original and candidate exist; future evaluation, not current development scenario testing.

methods.mechanism: Capture traffic, infer provisional schema and explore producer/consumer chains.
methods.invariant: Captured samples do not define the whole server contract.
methods.delta: mitmproxy replay, schema extraction and Schemathesis stateful checks are distinct layers.
methods.probe: Inspect an unseen stateful sequence with business assertions.
methods.limit: WebSockets, pinning and missing links/seeds require another path.
methods.license: MIT or MIT declared per component
methods.conditions: Authorized traffic observation and valid test state are available.

methods.mechanism: Use compile/fuzz feedback, discrepancy memory and best-candidate retention.
methods.invariant: Compilation and finite agreement do not establish equivalence.
methods.delta: CHISEL source-based reference harness differs from an arbitrary-binary oracle.
methods.probe: Locate a counterexample, preserve it, and inspect a bounded critical function.
methods.limit: Research source licensing unresolved; benchmark scope narrow; specialist models have separate terms.
methods.license: No license found; mechanism study only
methods.conditions: Trusted function oracle exists; source implementation must not cross strict boundary.

methods.mechanism: Search for bounded function discrepancies beyond finite fuzzing.
methods.invariant: Preserve solver assumptions and unsupported operations.
methods.delta: D-Helix is a targeted counterexample route, not a whole-app oracle.
methods.probe: Compare one important numerical/protocol function under explicit bounds.
methods.limit: Path explosion and pinned research environment can dominate cost.
methods.conditions: Function is tractable and important enough to justify solver cost.

methods.mechanism: Record difficult execution once, then perform several analyses.
methods.invariant: Separate state/order evidence from perturbed timing.
methods.delta: PANDA guest replay and rr process replay have different architecture/environment constraints.
methods.probe: Verify replay determinism and required observation channel on the actual platform.
methods.limit: Neither universally records mobile GPU interfaces.
methods.license: MIT-style core with exceptions; PANDA GPLv2
methods.conditions: Supported environment and reproducible execution are available.

methods.mechanism: Fit parsimonious dynamics to controlled trajectories.
methods.invariant: Validate separate inputs and distinguish discrete events from smooth motion.
methods.delta: Weak/integral formulations can reduce derivative noise.
methods.probe: Contrast competing models on a trajectory not used for fitting.
methods.limit: Hidden state, RNG, projection and mode switches can defeat smooth equations.
methods.conditions: Observable trajectories and controlled inputs exist; model assumptions are explicit.

methods.mechanism: Compare eligible state-matched captures with decomposed visual signals.
methods.invariant: Record build/state/fixture/viewport/environment/decision identity.
methods.delta: Argos eligibility, Playwright stabilization and pixelmatch localized difference solve separate problems.
methods.probe: Compare against original-original variation; inspect localized differences.
methods.limit: Masks, stale baselines and image metrics can hide intended behavior or punish valid adaptation.
methods.conditions: Reference and candidate captures correspond to the same approved comparison contract.

methods.mechanism: Recover conventional chat behaviors separately from visual direction.
methods.invariant: Reader position, composition, failures, cancellation and tool states need explicit contracts.
methods.delta: assistant-ui scroll anchors and AI Elements native composition/failure handling are complementary.
methods.probe: Inspect relevant actual primitives and specify pending/error/return behavior before visual synthesis.
methods.limit: Components do not supply backend integration or prove audience fit.
methods.conditions: Product is conversational; select applicable conventions rather than copy an entire layout.

methods.mechanism: Recover selected direction and refresh changed dependencies selectively.
methods.invariant: Missing design documentation does not imply greenfield.
methods.delta: Superdesign exact context lineage and Impeccable operation routing preserve different forms of continuity.
methods.probe: Inspect changed dependencies and classify refinement versus redesign before generating.
methods.limit: Hashes cannot prove quality; newly added dependencies require discovery.
methods.conditions: An existing project or selected direction has reusable context.

methods.mechanism: Retrieve cues, exceptions and examples with an abstention path.
methods.invariant: Weak retrieval must not become authority over explicit project decisions.
methods.delta: UI UX Pro Max adds score/coverage/margin diagnostics; lexical relevance is not semantic fit.
methods.probe: Inspect a retrieved exception and check whether it changes the actual decision.
methods.limit: Corpus gaps and uncalibrated confidence cannot be solved by thresholds alone.
methods.conditions: Knowledge is recurring and retrieval saves context without erasing originals.

methods.mechanism: Judge artifact against task and reference authority before detector suggestions.
methods.invariant: Withhold builder persuasion while retaining audience, goal and constraints.
methods.delta: Impeccable judgment ordering and UICrit task-conditioned localized examples supply complementary cues.
methods.probe: Localize a concern in actual artifact and propose a discriminating check.
methods.limit: Critic agreement is not correctness; bounded study evidence does not prove universal quality.
methods.license: Apache-2.0; UICrit dataset CC BY 4.0 with separate image rights
methods.conditions: Actual artifact exists; critique is consequential and references are inspectable.

methods.mechanism: Decide whether motion serves the task before choosing animation.
methods.invariant: Preserve frequency, purpose, perceived speed and functional feedback cues.
methods.delta: Emil separates opportunity diagnosis from implementation recipes.
methods.probe: Inspect an actual repeated interaction; reject animation with no useful role.
methods.limit: Universal timing numbers and marketing defaults need task-specific qualification.
methods.conditions: Motion choice is unresolved; cue-based expertise is more useful than decorative generation.

methods.mechanism: Use the same state fixture in design examples and interaction checks.
methods.invariant: Keep actual integration checks separate from mocked stories.
methods.delta: Storybook portable stories carry args/decorators/play; tokens carry values but not composition.
methods.probe: Connect a chosen example to its state, contract and intended check.
methods.limit: Fixtures can omit backend and persistence failures.
methods.conditions: Rendered components have reusable states; avoid treating tokens as a full design grammar.

methods.mechanism: Transfer implementation-independent observed behavior through reviewed exports.
methods.invariant: Keep source-bearing evidence and implementer access separate.
methods.delta: Clean-room skill path hooks are not kernel isolation; compatibility projects have differing access histories.
methods.probe: Review spec independence then inspect actual denied file/tool/network/retrieval access.
methods.limit: Review declarations and fresh sessions do not establish enforced isolation.
methods.license: MIT; exact upstream terms still apply
methods.conditions: Strict independent implementation requested; analyst and implementer roles are separated.

methods.mechanism: Use small typed judgments for candidate ranking, routing or leak flags.
methods.invariant: Escalate consequential ambiguity; preserve originals and measure total repair cost.
methods.delta: TypeSafe/Jev typed judgments differ from RouteLLM model routing and local Von classifiers.
methods.probe: Compare hints against simple retrieval and relevant known failures before relying on confidence.
methods.limit: Closed services, context overflow, calibration bugs and benchmark mismatch prevent default certification.
methods.license: Apache-2.0; services/models have separate terms; verify revision before use
methods.conditions: Representative qualification exists; fast output is advisory, never a fidelity oracle.

methods.mechanism: Define target, sensor, next action, disturbance handling and stop; route feedback into the next producing operation.
methods.invariant: Feedback must alter the next decision or operation.
methods.delta: Separate judgment, repo-specific execution and durable conditional memory.
methods.probe: Trace one correction from observation to changed operation.
methods.limit: No scheduling or effectiveness is established by describing the loop.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse
methods.conditions: Conditional transfer after inspecting fit; analyst-side in strict mode. See expert-integration.md for scope and inspected files.

methods.mechanism: Bound work in progress by actual human review capacity.
methods.invariant: Retain unresolved work without creating review debt.
methods.delta: An open review can suppress repetitive automated proposals, not independent useful research.
methods.probe: Inspect outstanding review and downstream dependencies before producing another artifact.
methods.limit: Open PR count is only a rough proxy for cognitive load.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse
methods.conditions: Conditional transfer after inspecting fit; analyst-side in strict mode. See expert-integration.md for scope and inspected files.

methods.mechanism: Move recurring deterministic mistakes into types, validation, shared components or checks before growing instructions.
methods.invariant: Preserve the correction purpose and scope.
methods.delta: Judgment remains conditional; not every taste issue has a deterministic rule.
methods.probe: Show the failure path is intercepted by the actual enforcing operation.
methods.limit: Receipt or agreement does not prove enforcement or improvement.

methods.mechanism: When repairs repeatedly fail, test competing premises rather than patching the same symptom.
methods.invariant: Use a discriminating observation.
methods.delta: A resource census fits imbalance problems, not every failure.
methods.probe: Specify observations that would distinguish at least two causal explanations.
methods.limit: A plausible story remains a hypothesis until tested.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse

methods.mechanism: Map rendered fields to their actual input boundaries and plausible or schema-backed extremes.
methods.invariant: Change inputs through the real boundary; preserve the component under examination.
methods.delta: Short, absent, singular, localized and empty values matter alongside long text.
methods.probe: Inspect real contracts; later render ordinary and extreme fixtures and preserve counterexamples.
methods.limit: Source review cannot establish rendered robustness; no actual scenario execution during package construction.

methods.mechanism: Compare variants that differ on a consequential design axis in realistic full-scale context.
methods.invariant: Same task, content and surrounding product context.
methods.delta: Keep variant generation separate from data robustness and motion review.
methods.probe: State the unresolved choice and what each variant would teach.
methods.limit: Fixed variant counts and compulsory approval are author policies, not universal requirements.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse
methods.conditions: Conditional transfer after inspecting fit; analyst-side in strict mode. See expert-integration.md for scope and inspected files.

methods.mechanism: Inspect installed components, actual CLI output, framework, base primitives and registry changes before adding UI.
methods.invariant: Respect the project configuration and real component API.
methods.delta: Preview generated file/dependency/CSS changes; prose API summaries can lag runtime schema.
methods.probe: Compare actual output and existing source to proposed additions.
methods.limit: Registry access and dry-run transitive effects require inspection; no automatic installation.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse
methods.conditions: Conditional transfer after inspecting fit; analyst-side in strict mode. See expert-integration.md for scope and inspected files.

methods.mechanism: Represent consequential decisions as a dependency tree; ask only the currently answerable frontier.
methods.invariant: Do not ask questions that depend on unsettled answers or inspectable facts.
methods.delta: Batch independent questions, then recompute after replies; retain reversible scoped intent reuse.
methods.probe: Check prerequisites and show independent work while dependent decisions wait.
methods.limit: Grilling every branch and requiring final confirmation would add avoidable user burden.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse
methods.conditions: Conditional transfer after inspecting fit; analyst-side in strict mode. See expert-integration.md for scope and inspected files.

methods.mechanism: Build a reproducible disposable probe for a specific uncertainty and expose relevant state.
methods.invariant: Preserve the question, inputs, execution recipe, observation and verdict.
methods.delta: Logic/state uncertainty and visual uncertainty require different probes.
methods.probe: Define competing outcomes before writing code; promote only supported properties.
methods.limit: Cheap code does not imply cheap evaluation or authorize external effects.

methods.mechanism: Compare materially different interface choices under the same constraints.
methods.invariant: Evaluate common caller simplicity, flexibility, locality and hidden complexity.
methods.delta: Different design constraints reveal alternatives a single favored sketch may miss.
methods.probe: Inspect realistic caller examples and failure contracts before selecting.
methods.limit: Fixed multi-agent counts are unnecessary; agreement is not correctness.
methods.license: MIT observed at inspected revision; recheck exact files before reuse

methods.mechanism: Reuse only qualified actions under explicit starting conditions and identity; run outcome assertions live and hand off on ambiguity or changed state.
methods.invariant: Preserve actual evidence and declared scope.
methods.delta: Separate operation reuse from verdict reuse; separate mechanical policy from semantic correctness.
methods.probe: Inspect the actual executing boundary, invalidation and failure path.
methods.limit: Recorded observable effects do not establish whole-state equivalence; no cost reduction measured here.
methods.conditions: Inspect fit and exact revision before adoption; see expert-integration.md.

methods.mechanism: Parse external data at boundaries, retain precise evidence and mechanically reject selected unsupported conversions.
methods.invariant: Preserve actual evidence and declared scope.
methods.delta: Separate operation reuse from verdict reuse; separate mechanical policy from semantic correctness.
methods.probe: Inspect the actual executing boundary, invalidation and failure path.
methods.limit: AST policy is bounded and language-specific; do not universalize author taste or mistake a comment for proof.
methods.conditions: Inspect fit and exact revision before adoption; see expert-integration.md.

methods.mechanism: Model critical histories and interleavings; preserve environmental and fairness assumptions.
methods.invariant: The property is derived from intent and observed contracts, not weakened to fit a candidate.
methods.delta: TLA+/P explore abstract transitions; Stateright can share actor code with runtime.
methods.probe: Find a counterexample, reproduce it in the implementation, then recheck both after repair.
methods.limit: Bounded model success does not establish implementation conformance or visual quality.
methods.conditions: Consequential state, ordering or exact-rule uncertainty; read formal-methods.md and qualify the tool before adoption.

methods.mechanism: Map captured logs/actions into explicit monitor events with identity, ordering and partitions.
methods.invariant: The event mapping retains relevant behavior and exposes missing observations.
methods.delta: PObserve links monitor specifications to logs rather than stopping at design-time models.
methods.probe: Replay a distinguishing observed trace and inspect parser omissions and monitor outcomes.
methods.limit: Missing events or incorrect ordering can make a monitor misleading.
methods.conditions: Consequential state, ordering or exact-rule uncertainty; read formal-methods.md and qualify the tool before adoption.

methods.mechanism: Explore supported concurrency and save reproducible failure schedules against actual code.
methods.invariant: Suspected race evidence survives into an implementation reproduction.
methods.delta: Coyote instruments C# execution; separate abstract models require an additional conformance bridge.
methods.probe: Reproduce the saved schedule before and after repair while qualifying uncontrolled effects.
methods.limit: Only supported controlled operations participate; this is not arbitrary native/application coverage.
methods.conditions: Consequential state, ordering or exact-rule uncertainty; read formal-methods.md and qualify the tool before adoption.

methods.mechanism: Separate intended theorem statement, accepted proof and transitive axiom/replay evidence.
methods.invariant: The statement and assumptions continue to express the independently reviewed objective.
methods.delta: Lean comparator checks against a trusted statement; successful generation/build alone is weaker.
methods.probe: Inspect statement meaning and transitive axioms; qualify independent replay when consequence warrants.
methods.limit: A correct proof of the wrong abstraction does not establish the intended product behavior.
methods.conditions: Consequential state, ordering or exact-rule uncertainty; read formal-methods.md and qualify the tool before adoption.

methods.mechanism: Retain native hierarchy and rendered layout with page, bounding-box, span and table-coordinate provenance.
methods.invariant: Do not flatten structure and visual evidence into one authoritative text stream.
methods.delta: Docling conversion status and provenance expose omissions; native table spans preserve distinctions lost in Markdown.
methods.probe: Check consequential reading order and merged cells against actual rendered pages.
methods.limit: Parsing confidence is not layout fidelity; OCR and model terms require separate review.
methods.conditions: Conditional surface-specific transfer; read surface-methods.md. Original source-bearing structures remain analyst-side in strict mode.

methods.mechanism: Inventory native objects and relationships, edit a narrow boundary, save, reopen and compare intended and unintended changes.
methods.invariant: Preserve required formatting and relationships outside the intended edit.
methods.delta: python-docx paragraph text replacement removes run formatting; top-level inventories omit nested and revision structures.
methods.probe: Compare styles, links, table relationships and pagination after a controlled round trip.
methods.limit: Library save success does not certify all OOXML structures or appearance.
methods.conditions: Conditional surface-specific transfer; read surface-methods.md. Original source-bearing structures remain analyst-side in strict mode.

methods.mechanism: Retain integer presentation timestamps and rational time bases; seek to a preceding keyframe and decode forward.
methods.invariant: Do not infer exact time from frame index divided by average frame rate.
methods.delta: PyAV separates stream time bases, codec time bases and seek behavior.
methods.probe: Compare sequential and seek-forward timestamps around a relevant interval.
methods.limit: Media timestamps do not establish input latency or loss-free capture.
methods.conditions: Conditional surface-specific transfer; read surface-methods.md. Original source-bearing structures remain analyst-side in strict mode.

methods.mechanism: Retain raw sample intervals, channels, clock, trigger and loss evidence beside versioned decoder parameters.
methods.invariant: Decoded labels remain interpretations tied to raw measurements.
methods.delta: sigrok session metadata and protocol decoders answer different questions; fallback parameters must stay visible.
methods.probe: Compare known framing against raw edges and investigate warning, parity and missing-clock cases.
methods.limit: Sample metadata alone does not prove calibrated clocks, complete capture or physical equivalence.
